title: How I wanted to love this but no I can't
text:
How I wanted to love this but no I can't. I really thought this was an answer to my need. I have been using, alternately, cheapo screens and the OXO SS folding one. My complaint with the cheapo screens is dishwasher can do a number on them and doing them by hand can be tricky, shredding sponges and dishcloths. So I have been going back and forth with them, when they get too ratty doing by hand I stick them in the DW and hope for the best.

My OXO folding DWs wonderfully but it is not so great at catching the splatters, ok it sucks at catching the splatters but is better than no splatter screen on stuff.

I thought this was the answer. It is not. It is a swift PITA that builds up steam and drips water all over when I lift it to turn the food. Why they felt it was necessary to make half of it solid metal I don't know. They seem to have a very nice screen material, a little dense which helps catch more splatters and this whole thing seems to DW fine. But, all that solid metal collects a gallon of moisture underside and the minute you pick it up, it is all over the stove, burner, cooktop, whatever.

Very disappointed.
